summary: Stocks are trading lower across the board as surging oil prices and rising Treasury yields revive inflation worries. Chip stocks are leading the retreat even though TSMC and Samsung reported strong AI demand.
market_note: Oil up over 4 percent to $92; Fed minutes and Pepsi earnings due today.

items.why: Falling with chip peers as rising oil and Treasury yields overshadow strong TSMC and Samsung results that would normally lift semiconductor stocks.
Pressured by reports that the EU vote on Full Self-Driving approval slipped from October to December, delaying new subscription revenue and Tesla's European robotaxi plans.
Small caps are getting hit as rising oil and bond yields revive inflation fears, with the Fed minutes due later today adding to the caution.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape.
